summary: E2B's pricing page lists the Hobby plan at $0 with a $100 one-time usage credit. It includes sessions up to 1 hour, up to 20 concurrent sandboxes, and free 10 GiB storage. The page says no credit card is required; usage costs are separate after the included credit.
claim_steps: Open the E2B pricing page and choose the free Hobby plan.
Create or sign in to an E2B account; no credit card is required.
Use the included one-time $100 usage credit within the Hobby plan limits.

social_proof.title: Pricing | E2B — The AI Agent Cloud
social_proof.text: Hobby FREE; $100 one-time usage credit; sessions up to 1 hour; 20 concurrent sandboxes; no credit card required.
